native_policy.reason: Preserve native detailed geometry and PBR by default. Only evidence-local seam bridges and newly exposed hidden closure/socket surfaces may change after reviewer approval, within the named budgets. These permissions are maxima, not instructions to consume them.

repairs.name: separation_bridges
repairs.target: Only triangles spanning the evidenced insert/deck seams or the cover/base articulation cut; never intact bulb faces, dark patches, tips, rims, or unrelated underside detail.
repairs.reason: Native geometry contains a dominant connected surface across visually distinct regions. If seam-crossing triangles prevent separation, remove only demonstrated welded bridges, identified in labelled boundary closeups and an area ledger.

repairs.name: boundary_closure
repairs.target: New cut-boundary closure surfaces at cover/base split, insert undersides, and tip attachment roots.
repairs.reason: Moving the evidenced regions can expose unobserved open section boundaries; bounded local caps must retain the original visible silhouette and use adjacent native material values.

repairs.name: seat_completion
repairs.target: Hidden interior walls and floors directly below the two evidenced seating openings; existing exterior and upper deck excluded.
repairs.reason: Extraction requires physically clear sockets with visible completed interiors. Fit offset swept undersides through the approved removal direction; additions are visibly labelled inferred completion in the ledger.

repairs.name: seat_bridge_opening
repairs.target: Only native triangles forming an artificial sheet across an evidenced insert seat opening, inside the original seating boundary.
repairs.reason: A generated sheet may block removal or cover the inferred cavity; remove only if builder boundary and underside inspection demonstrates it, with per-face provenance and no enlargement beyond the evidenced seat.

selection.reason: Pale tapered medial protrusion has a visible neck against the glossy housing; this supports an attached compliant-region hypothesis.

young_modulus.reason: Editable effective elastic prior; single-image appearance does not determine stiffness.

poisson_ratio.reason: Compressible effective solid prior for numerical conditioning; no hidden hollow topology asserted.

mesh_spacing.reason: Target tetrahedron edge length; refine locally at the attachment and surface to satisfy exact convex skin binding.

root_collar_depth.reason: Pin the root-side collar to housing motion; collar extends from the observed seam into the tip, leaving exposed distal region deformable.

load_stroke.reason: Bounded contact indentation target, verified against actual rest tip extent and deformation.

probe_radius.reason: Rounded indenter prior, positioned on the exposed medial tip after extraction.

recovery_tolerance.reason: Maximum RMS residual tip displacement in owner-local coordinates after unload and recovery.

soft_regions.reason: The tapered pale attachment and visible neck make soft compliance more plausible than a rigid extension. Use one continuous effective solid per disconnected tip, not multiple colored-region volumes. Build a conforming covering tetrahedral MuJoCo flex with root vertices attached to the moving housing and skin bound by nonnegative barycentric weights. Solid interior is a declared mechanical prior, not an observed cavity claim.

interactions.name: cover_sweep_return
interactions.action: With both inserts seated, use real hinge actuation from native q=0 to q=2.09 rad in a slow sweep, hold, and return. Inspect intermediate clearance and terminal rim alignment; measure all contact penetrations each integration step. Then repeat a partial sweep with one insert extracted to test independence.
interactions.expected: Cover native mesh moves with measured hinge state and returns; terminal cover rim approaches the container rim within 0.002 m without visible overlap or any penetration exceeding policy 0.002 asset diagonal. No latch behavior is claimed. If geometry contacts early or the inferred pivot cannot realize the declared travel, report failure/replan; do not relabel a shortened sweep as closed.

interactions.name: left_extract_reseat
interactions.action: Hold the cover at source-open pose. Apply a smooth force/pose servo to the free housing along native-normal direction (0,0.5734623444,0.8192319205) through 0.025 m, hold, then return along the same path and settle into its socket. Test left and right independently, then together; no invented slide rail, weld, magnet or latch.
interactions.expected: Housing and attached flex root follow actual simulated body motion. Selected assembly clears its seat and reveals completed interior/underside. Other assembly stays seated within 0.0003 m. Return housing within 0.0005 m and 0.03 rad of seated pose. Native surface displacement exceeds policy 0.01 asset diagonal, no penetrating contact above policy threshold, and no floating detached root or crack at soft binding.

interactions.name: left_tip_load_recover
interactions.action: After extraction, settle and support housing by an external test servo. Approach the exposed medial tip with a 0.002 m radius contact probe, ramp indentation to 0.0015 m, hold, withdraw fully, recover for up to 2 s, and then reseat. Use recorded real contact and actual MuJoCo flex motion, measuring skin in the housing frame so free-body motion is excluded.
interactions.expected: Nonzero probe contact force and spatially varying strain; peak distal nonrigid surface displacement at least 0.01 metric asset diagonal, root binding error below 0.0001 m, and unloaded RMS residual below 0.00015 m. Rest skin reconstruction within 0.001 asset diagonal with nonnegative weights. No inverted tets, solver instability, or contact penetration above policy 0.002 asset diagonal. Physics or binding failure remains failure, never a rigid substitution.

review_requirements: Evaluate over final declared reachable range under v020 motion policy; original fixed full-closure/endpoint demands are diagnostic only. Other requirements remain: Account for all 191699 stable native faces exactly once as a preserved owner or a named removed face. Verify four rigid regions and two dedicated tip skins with no duplicate tip surface on housing roots. Inspect labeled rest-pose overlays in all six native views, including tip necks, insert/deck boundaries, both cover skins and depressions, thin rims and hinge strip. Verify rest-frame reconstruction, native UV/material preservation and uniform SI scale; seed-based output that crosses an intact lobe fails.

Evaluate over final declared reachable range under v020 motion policy; original fixed full-closure/endpoint demands are diagnostic only. Other requirements remain: For each removal provide a before/after closeup and face IDs demonstrating a seam bridge or artificial seat sheet. Measure area fractions against original native area: separation bridges <=0.02, seat bridge opening <=0.01, total removed <=0.03, edited=0, boundary closures <=0.06, seat completion <=0.14, total added <=0.20. Inspect both extracted undersides, open sockets and cover cut boundaries at actuated endpoints: no visible open cuts, blocked seating cavity, expanded seat boundary or unrelated detail loss. No repair is justified solely by mesh connectedness.

Evaluate over final declared reachable range under v020 motion policy; original fixed full-closure/endpoint demands are diagnostic only. Other requirements remain: Using actual mj_step, demonstrate the declared cover hinge from q=0 to q=2.09 rad, hold and return with both inserts seated, plus the specified partial sweep with one extracted. Record achieved angles, source-return pose, native surface displacement and sampled matching rim distances across the rim at closure, not merely nearest-point contact; terminal alignment must meet 0.002 m without visible overlap. Inspect intermediate swept clearance and every endpoint. Retain cover/container and cover/insert collision outside the documented hinge collar, explicitly addressing parent-child collision filtering. Early contact or insufficient travel is failure/replan, not closed-state success.

Evaluate over final declared reachable range under v020 motion policy; original fixed full-closure/endpoint demands are diagnostic only. Other requirements remain: Simulate left and right extraction/reseating separately and together along the declared normal through 0.025 m. Demonstrate seat clearance and native mesh motion >=0.01 metric native diagonal. During separate extraction the other assembly remains within 0.0003 m of its seated position. After return, each housing is within 0.0005 m and 0.03 rad of its seated pose. Show the corresponding flex root follows its owner throughout, and measure seat contact with concave collision coverage rather than socket-filling hulls. Document external servos/support forces without adding permanent rails, welds or magnetic constraints.

Evaluate over final declared reachable range under v020 motion policy; original fixed full-closure/endpoint demands are diagnostic only. Other requirements remain: For left_tip and right_tip separately, verify positive-volume covering tetrahedra, full native skin coverage, nonnegative sum-one barycentric weights and rest reconstruction error <=0.001 metric native diagonal. Demonstrate root collar coverage and attachment error <0.0001 m during extraction and loading. With extracted housing supported, use a 0.002 m probe and the declared 0.0015 m indentation target; record actual contact force, stroke, owner-local skin displacements and spatially varying strain. Peak distal nonrigid displacement must reach >=0.01 metric native diagonal, with visible local deformation beyond root motion. After complete probe withdrawal, RMS residual must be <0.00015 m within 2 s. Both regions require actual flex response with no inverted tetrahedra, rigid duplicate skin, hidden offsets or clamped binding weights.

Evaluate over final declared reachable range under v020 motion policy; original fixed full-closure/endpoint demands are diagnostic only. Other requirements remain: For all approved interactions, measure penetration at every integration step against the policy limit of 0.002 metric native diagonal, and verify finite stable body/flex states. Record enabled collision coverage and all local exclusions; do not disable relevant contacts to pass. Render and browser playback must use the same measured MuJoCo body states and flex binding weights. Inspect rest, extraction, closure, loaded and recovered endpoints for visible native surface motion, attachment continuity and absence of interpenetration; passing collision-proxy measurements alone cannot excuse visible mesh intersections.

Evaluate over final declared reachable range under v020 motion policy; original fixed full-closure/endpoint demands are diagnostic only. Other requirements remain: Before physical binding, produce an ownership overlay and seam closeups matching obs01_requested_0 in addition to the inherited six standard views. Report actual nearest-centroid seed IDs and boundary face IDs. Verify the entire rear bowl and both skins belong to cover, the seating deck and stationary strip to container, each dark patch to its housing and each medial protrusion exclusively to its tip skin. Check thin paired faces in 3D adjacency; any smooth-lobe clipping, deck captured as tip, missing inner/outer skin or duplicated surface fails and requires corrected selection within approved bounds or explicit failure.
